instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.content:
# Welcome to Training IDE

## Getting Started

1. Follow the lab instructions on the left
2. Use the editor to write your code
3. Run commands in the terminal below

This is a **dockable** interface - you can:
- Drag panels to reorganize
- Click and drag borders to resize
- Double-click titles to maximize panels
